catalog.conditions: Actual startup import, synthetic healthy frontend/API/gateway subprocesses, actual catalog refresh subprocess and real disposable descendant; transient refresh/probe processes excluded from persistent child count. No browser/provider/live service changes.

deadlineRepair.behavior: 180-second deadline and shutdown share generation-bound Windows tree cleanup. Both wait actual child close and native cleanup settlement. Inconclusive cleanup disables further automatic refreshes and remains a supervisor-stop failure. Ordinary completed refresh errors retain scheduled retry.
deadlineRepair.regressionConditions: Controlled fake interval/deadline advancement and IPC-ready real disposable catalog/probe children. Real native tree cleanup, actual close observation, intentionally delayed proof handoff. Complete cleanup permits next check; withheld/inconclusive proof prevents it. No sleeps added; previous readiness polling replaced with IPC.

browserPrograms.limits: Source serialization only. Stronger interrupted recovery is larger; ordinary turns exclude that source. No browser latency claim.

verification.localTestReview: Added and modified cases protect ongoing recovery ownership, exact replay, persistence custody, stamp rollback and process-tree nonoverlap. No one-off edit-spelling tests retained.
